data.body: **P1 — Propagate MDC restoration failures before publishing the outcome.** This completes `result` with the selected success/PENDING/retry outcome even when `restore.close()` throws. On an asynchronous executor, a `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` therefore reaches only the worker while Lambda returns normally; an ordinary inline failure is swallowed later and can leave the caller's MDC altered. Capture the restoration failure first, complete `result` exceptionally for JVM-fatal failures, and retry or propagate ordinary restoration failures before returning.
